items.quote: Direct reports said that Samon Brenuen set the direction for public communications on the new scheme across the public service.
Peers observed that Samon took ownership of lean process reviews at the service centres and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Samon participated in change management after the merger of two units as a team member.
Several respondents noted that Samon delivered their share of the five-year strategic plan for the division reliably.
Samon championed engagement with industry stakeholders and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
